messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High GPU pool saturation detected in eu-west-1. queue_length=432, inflight=320, autoscaler_failed=true, reason=\"scale_limit_reached\". Paging oncall.
Maria (oncall): acked. investigating. starting triage. @Jamie can you join? i'll open bridge.
Jamie (sre): on it. looking at autoscaler logs now. suspected spike from batch ingestion + a sustained llm chat burst.
Maria (oncall): customers seeing 429 and rising latencies per frontend. top 2 customers account for ~45% of queue.
Chris (runtime): autoscaler tried to spin up new nodes but provider rate limited us; also max_replicas=50 hit. current pools: 50/50 allocated.
Sanjay (ml): can we fallback hot traffic to smaller quantized model? reduce per-request GPU mem by ~40%.
Maria (oncall): good idea. Jamie, can you enable emergency-burst capacity? runbook: /runbooks/autoscale/emergency-burst
Jamie (sre): doing emergency-burst now: patching autoscaler max_replicas -> 80 and provider-burst -> true. running:
```
kubectl patch deploy autoscaler -n infra --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/maxReplicas","value":80}]'
``` 
OpsBridgeBot: Bridge created: https://bridge.company/meet/1769456789 (host: Maria)
Maria (oncall): applying throttles to background queues and evicting long-running low-priority jobs. tagging customer-impact for comms.
Jamie (sre): patch applied; provider reported slow node provisioning; spinning up extra preemptible nodes as stopgap.
Chris (runtime): rolling fallback routing: traffic tag \"fallback-small\" -> model: redwood-small-quant-v1. Deploying proxy rule now.
Sanjay (ml): fallback deployed and warmed. initial p99 latency improved ~30% on canary.
Maria (oncall): observed queue shrink from 432 -> 120 over 9 minutes. still seeing 20% failure on encrypted batch jobs.
Zoe (prod): opening customer comms: affected customers list prepared, pre-draft to release in 15min. need confirmation of incident ETA.
Jamie (sre): mitigation timeline: emergency-burst enabled, fallback routing active, background throttles in place. next: monitor provider node readiness and autoscaler logs.
Maria (oncall): Can we avoid full scale-up in the future? action item: add alert when autoscaler hits 90% of max_replicas and scaling fails for >2min.
Chris (runtime): noted. also tuning suggestion: increase default max_replicas for eu-west-1 to 100 and add provider-burst budget. also add faster fallback routing for large-model requests.
Jamie (sre): created temporary dashboard: https://grafana.company/d/abc/autoscale-surge with queue_length, max_replicas, provider_errors.
Maria (oncall): customer update posted. :white_check_mark:
Zoe (prod): sent. customers asked for ETA; we'll update in 30.
Jamie (sre): provider reports additional nodes ready; pool at 78/80 now. autoscaler resumed normal operation.
Sanjay (ml): traffic shifted back to main model for high-priority customers. monitoring quality metrics for regressions.
Maria (oncall): closing bridge in 10m unless regressions. preparing postmortem draft. assign owners for action items.
Jamie (sre): action items:
- increase autoscaler max default for eu-west-1 -> owner: Jamie
- add alert on scaling-latency and failed-scale -> owner: Maria
- pre-warm quantized model replicas at traffic threshold -> owner: Sanjay
- provider quota check & burst budget -> owner: Chris
Maria (oncall): I'll take the incident writeup and timeline. want preliminary postmortem by EOD. tag: postmortem/priority-high
Zoe (prod): I'll follow-up with customers and coordinate any credits if needed.
OpsBridgeBot: Incident resolved, status: mitigated. bridge archived.
Maria (oncall): final note: root cause: combined customer burst + autoscaler hitting conservative max + provider provisioning rate limits. long-term fixes above. good triage team. :clap:
Jamie (sre): adding retrospective item: runchaos test for rapid surge to validate autoscale path.
Sanjay (ml): will add eval for fallback-small to ensure quality parity on rollbacks.
Maria (oncall): last message before handoff to next oncall (Jamie->Taylor). Handoff: incident mitigated, watchlist for next 12h.
Taylor (oncall-next): ack. I'll keep an eye on queue and provider quotas. thanks team.
